summary: German Chancellor Angela Merkel offered to share Germany’s experience with renewable energy to help South Africa address its power crisis and reduce emissions. During her visit, Merkel and President Cyril Ramaphosa discussed energy, trade and vocational training. Merkel said Germany would offer young people a one-year training programme through the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation. Ramaphosa called for deeper trade with Germany and said his government aimed to reduce youth unemployment through skills development.
